entities.name: Plant Fiber Weaving
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Impressions of woven plant fibers have been found on clay fragments from Dolní Věstonice (Czech Republic). Flax, hemp, and nettle fibers were twisted into thread and woven into fabric long before agriculture.
